label: Level
description: country, region, district or city; the table prints the four cities in its district column, after the districts of their region

label: Region
description: The region a district or city lies in; empty for the country and the regions

label: Unit
description: The unit's name as the NSO workbook writes it

label: Male
description: Male population, 2018 Population and Housing Census (the workbook's 2018 Male column)

label: Female
description: Female population, 2018 Population and Housing Census (the workbook's 2018 Female column)

label: Total
description: Population, both sexes, 2018 Population and Housing Census (the workbook's 2018 Total column)

label: Table
description: The workbook sheet the row was read from

label: Cells
description: The workbook cells the row was read from (B Total, C Male, D Female)
